answer: Maliciously secure MPC attaches a MAC to every shared value, and the spiral of the construction is that the MAC key itself is secret-shared, so nobody can forge an authentication tag. The island of the design is a final verification round where all MACs are checked before any output is opened, which catches cheaters with overwhelming probability. A Sybil participant who tampers with its shares is detected and its input discarded, and the crystal of the check guarantees the result reflects only honest inputs.
